name: 约翰·阿塔纳索夫
bio_short: 美国物理学家和发明家，被法律认可的“电子计算机之父”。他在爱荷华州立学院期间，与学生克利福德·贝里共同发明了ABC计算机（`abc_computer_1942`），不仅率先使用了二进制电子运算，还发明了类似于现代内存（DRAM）的存储机制。
bio_short_en: An American physicist and inventor, legally recognized as the 'Father of the Electronic Computer'. While at Iowa State College, he co-invented the ABC computer with student Clifford Berry (`abc_computer_1942`), pioneering binary electronic computation and inventing a storage mechanism similar to modern memory (DRAM).
